age.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (6-8 weeks old) obtained from Jackson Labs (Bar Harbor, ME)

dosing.doses_raw: 0.4 mg/kg, 0.8 mg/kg (Table 4); preliminary experiment with 1 or 2 mg/kg (data not shown)
dosing.evidence: Psilocin was dissolved in 0.05 mM tartaric acid and the pH was adjusted to 5-6 using 1 N NaOH... psilocin, M100907, and SB-242,084 were administered subcutaneously (SC). Psilocin was administered 2 min prior to the start of the test session.

dosing.doses_raw: 3 mg/kg DOI (IP); DOI (2 µg/side) infused bilaterally into the mPFC
dosing.evidence: DOI was dissolved in isotonic saline. DOI was administered intraperitoneally (IP)... DOI (2 µg/side) or vehicle (a 3:1 mixture of aCSF and isotonic saline) was infused bilaterally into the mPFC
M100907 was dissolved in water containing 5% Tween 80... M100907 and MDL-11,939 were administered 30 min prior to the start of the test session.
MDL 11,939 was dissolved in water containing 1% Tween 80... administered 30 min prior to the start of the test session.
WAY-100,635 was dissolved in water... WAY-100,635 was administered 25 min prior to the start of the test session.

group_housing.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice... were housed up to 4 per cage in a climate controlled room

day_night_flipped.evidence: on a reversed light cycle (lights on at 1900 h, lights off at 0700 h)... trained 5-7 days a week at the same time each day during the dark (awake) phase

assays.assay_description: Operant retrospective timing task in 2-lever Med Associates chambers (21.6 × 17.8 × 12.7 cm, grid floor, sound-attenuating box). After trial initiation, a variable interval (2.5-10.5 s) elapsed, then levers were presented; lever A reinforced for <6.5 s, lever B for >6.5 s, with liquid reinforcement (Strawberry Nesquik in milk). Test sessions lasted 45 min or 200 trials. Measures: %B responding by stimulus duration, T50, DL, WF, slope, r2, trials completed. Manipulations collapsed: psilocin (0.4, 0.8 mg/kg SC) alone and with WAY-100,635 or M100907 pretreatment; systemic DOI (3 mg/kg IP); intra-mPFC DOI (2 µg/side); antagonist/inverse agonist dose-responses alone.

application_type.evidence: DOI was administered intraperitoneally (IP); psilocin, M100907, and SB-242,084 were administered subcutaneously (SC)... DOI (2 µg/side) or vehicle... was infused bilaterally into the mPFC

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were first trained using a session (HAB1)... In the second phase of training (HAB2)... Mice were then trained on the TDT... Training was also conducted between experimental test sessions

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were trained and tested in 2-lever operant chambers; no restraint described during the session.

food_restriction.evidence: A peristaltic pump... delivered liquid reinforcement (Strawberry Nesquik® in non-fat milk, 20 µL) to a well in the floor of the magazine. (Note: mice were maintained at 85% of their free-feeding weight.)

water_restriction.evidence: Water was provided ad libitum except during behavioral training and testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocin was administered 2 min prior to the start of the test session. DOI was administered 10 min prior to the start of the test session... Animals were placed in the operant chambers for experimental testing 5 min after the end of the infusion.

sample_size.evidence: Table 4: Vehicle (n = 13), 0.4 mg/kg (n = 10), 0.8 mg/kg (n = 10); Table 5: WAY-100,635 + psilocin (n = 12); Table 6: M100907 + psilocin (n = 15); Table 7: Vehicle (n = 16), DOI (2 µg/side) (n = 17). Antagonist-only experiments had groups as small as n = 8 (WAY-100,635 0.25 mg/kg).

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (0.8 mg/kg SC, but not 0.4 mg/kg) shifted the psychometric function rightward, increasing T50 and DL and reducing trials completed and r2. The psilocin effect was blocked by the 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 but not by the 5-HT1A antagonist WAY-100,635. Systemic DOI (3 mg/kg IP) and bilateral intra-mPFC DOI (2 µg/side) also increased T50.
outcomes.evidence: the highest dose of psilocin (0.8 mg/kg) shifted the psychometric curve to the right, significantly reducing %B responding at 6.9, 7.8, 8.7, 9.6, and 10.5 s after trial onset (p < 0.05 and 0.01, Dunnett's test) and increasing T50 from 6.73 ± 0.16 s to 7.69 ± 0.26 s (p < 0.01, Dunnett's test).

B1_num_measures.evidence: %B responding, T50, Difference Limen, Weber Fraction, slope (ε), and trials completed (r2 is a goodness-of-fit statistic, not a behavioural variable).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as session totals of %B responding as a function of stimulus duration; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions or response sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Operant lever-press task; no ethological behaviours measured.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in operant chambers.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Training continued until all mice reached a criterion of 85% correct performance... retrospective timing schedule requiring learned temporal discrimination.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Stimuli were controlled and responses were recorded using a SmartCtrl Package... interfacing with MED-PC for Windows (Med Associates Inc.)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Data analysed with ANOVAs and logistic curve fitting; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Mice were trained and tested in 2-lever operant chambers (21.6 × 17.8 × 12.7 cm, Med Associates Inc)

E3_bedding.evidence: 2 motor-driven retractable levers located 2.2 cm above the grid floor

E5_enrichment.evidence: definitionally absent (standard operant chamber; only levers, magazine, lights)

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice tested individually in operant chambers.

E8_food_water.evidence: A peristaltic pump... delivered liquid reinforcement (Strawberry Nesquik® in non-fat milk, 20 µL) to a well in the floor of the magazine.

D1_continuity.evidence: Antagonist blockade experiments were performed using a partial crossover within-subjects design where... the drug treatment varied depending on the test day; training data across sessions reported (Fig. 1).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Figure 1 illustrates task performance for one cohort (N = 56 mice) during the first 45 training sessions; plus multiple separate test days across experiments.

D4_baseline.evidence: Fig. 1... Change in proportional choice of lever B (%B responding) for the two extreme stimulus durations over the first 45 training sessions (pre-drug training data in the same apparatus reported).

D5_followup.evidence: All tests conducted 2-30 min after dosing; no recording ≥24 h post-drug reported as an outcome.

judge_notes: Single assay (TDT); gemma4's output split this assay into two malformed fragments — merged. All dose-response, antagonist-blockade, systemic DOI, and intra-mPFC DOI experiments collapsed into one TDT assay per rubric. Histology excluded (non-behavioural).
B1: scored 4-6 (score 2): r2 is a curve-fit statistic, not a behavioural variable; gemma4's score 3 conflicted with its own '4-6' value.
D3: overridden to 15+ because Fig. 1 reports behavioural data across 45 training sessions in the same apparatus; D4 = Yes (modal) on the same basis.

time_to_assay: set to acute_0to2h rather than 'multiple' — all psychedelic dosing-to-test intervals (2 min psilocin, 10 min systemic DOI, 5 min post-infusion) fall in the same acute window; 'multiple' is intended for distinct timepoints like 30 min vs 24 h.

food_restriction: 'no' (modal; rubric lists food-reward operant tasks as 'no'), although mice were maintained at 85% free-feeding weight. water_restriction: 'during' per explicit text 'ad libitum except during behavioral training and testing'.

n_per_group_min = 10 based on psychedelic-treatment experiments (psilocin dose-response); antagonist-only experiments had n=8 minimum. n_total left null because animals were reused across experiments.
Added non-psychedelic drug entries (M100907, MDL 11,939, WAY-100,635) to dosing since rubric asks for every compound administered; routes for MDL 11,939 and WAY-100,635 not explicitly stated.
sex.n_male set to null (qwen's 56 referred to a single training cohort, not the total study).
